New York: a Diamond District dealer pleaded guilty to a four-year, $438,000 fraud scheme built on forged checks.

Arsen Canaj paid sellers with forged checks for a diamond, a Rolex and parcels of jewelry and emeralds, 2018-2021, Manhattan DA Alvin Bragg's office said. He pleaded guilty to Grand Larceny, sentencing 13 November.
